banner.title: openebs-hostpath
banner.tagline: Provides the openebs-hostpath StorageClass: node-local volumes, each a directory on one node's disk, for claims that need no replicas.

art.about: a node-local storage class that serves directories from one node's disk
art.title: How openebs-hostpath serves a volume

explainer.title: A node-local volume, tied to the node that holds it

steps.title: Chart
steps.text: An OCIRepository pulls the openebs chart. The HelmRelease keeps only the hostpath LocalPV provisioner and turns off the ZFS, LVM, Mayastor, MinIO and logging subcharts.
steps.scene: a package box with one drawer open

steps.title: Class
steps.text: The chart creates StorageClass openebs-hostpath. It is not the default class, so a claim has to name it.
steps.scene: a labelled storage bin on a shelf

steps.title: Bind
steps.text: A volume is a directory under /var/openebs/local on one node. It cannot follow a pod to another node.
steps.scene: a directory tree rooted in a single disk

steps.title: Stay
steps.text: Nothing is replicated. CNPG cluster-18 and the Ceph metadata backup PVC use this class, and a host wipe destroys its volumes, so each depends on its own backup path.
steps.scene: a locked vault bolted to one machine
